47:20.text: Those who believe say: "Why is not a Sûrah
therein, you will see those in whose hearts is a disease
looking at you with a look of one fainting to death. But it was better for them
(hypocrites, to listen to Allâh and to obey Him)

47:21.text: is resolved on, then if they had been true to Allâh, it would have been better for them.

47:22.text: Would you then, if you were given the authority, do mischief in the land, and sever your ties of kinship?

47:23.text: Such are they whom Allâh has cursed, so that He has made them deaf and blinded their sight.

47:24.text: Do they not then think deeply in the Qur’ân, or are their hearts locked up

47:25.text: Verily, those who have turned back
as disbelievers after the guidance has been manifested to them - Shaitân

47:26.text: This is because they said to those who hate what Allâh has sent down: "We will obey you in part of the matter." But Allâh knows their secrets.

47:27.text: when the angels will take their souls at death, smiting their faces and their backs?

47:28.text: That is because they followed that which angered Allâh and hated that which pleased Him. So He made their deeds fruitless.

47:29.text: Or do those in whose hearts is a disease
, think that Allâh will not bring to light all their hidden ill-wills?
